description: Mass-formula assembly chain for the proton at 50 dps.  Replaces the f64 chain `proton-mass-assembly-MeV` (PR #476) with a precision-lifted version anchored in the fully-trusted Markov-trace assembly chain (PR #480) and the Phase A 50 dps Terms 2–6 (PR #476).  Trust profile {axiom: 0, derived: 2, script-cited: 3, computational: 1} — the SCRIPT_CITED frontier still covers the T1+T2+T3+T4 mass-endomorphism tower assembly.  Current proton mass prediction: 966.05 MeV vs CODATA 938.27208816 (rel_diff 0.0296, 2.9605e+7 ppb).  Target: 1 ppb.

steps.name: tr_M(p, q_0) at 50 dps via Markov-trace assembly chain
steps.operation: Reference `markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json` (fully-trusted on main as of PR #480).  The 50 dps evaluation comes from `atomic_tr_m_mpfr_50dps.py`'s Wenzl-bridge pipeline (mpmath at 50 dps); cross-checked against the polynomial-ring path at machine precision via `markov_pipeline_cross_validator`.
steps.notes: Derivation chain: markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json (fully-trusted, profile {axiom: 1, derived: 6, script-cited: 0, computational: 1}).  Numerical eval at 50 dps via Wenzl-bridge (atomic_tr_m_mpfr_50dps.py).

steps.name: Mass-formula Terms 2–6 at 50 dps (Phase A precision lift)
steps.operation: Reference `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json` (produced by `mass_formula_6term_mpfr_50dps.py` from PR #476's Phase A precision lift).  All six unified-mass-formula terms evaluated at 50 dps mpmath: Term 1 (descended trace), Term 2/3 (Φ_q tower via mp_Phi_q), Term 4 (Frobenius co-Casimir), Term 5 (chirality BW), Term 6 (Habiro residue tail).
steps.notes: script: computations/mass_formula_6term_mpfr_50dps.py.  SCRIPT_CITED — the per-term assembly into a single mass-cat-units value awaits its own derivation chain (open frontier: terms 2-6 individually need per-term chains analogous to the σ_shell A=2 closed form for Term 7).

steps.name: m_p_Hecke (proton mass in cat units, 50 dps)
steps.operation: Sum the four-term mass-endomorphism tower for the proton at 50 dps, drawing each term from the Phase A precision lift in step 2.  Currently SCRIPT_CITED via `mass_endomorphism.py` + `proton_mass_tower_derivation.py` until the per-term chains close.
steps.notes: script: computations/mass_endomorphism.py + proton_mass_tower_derivation.py.  SCRIPT_CITED — the T1+T2+T3+T4 assembly itself awaits its own derivation chain.  Phase A item (50 dps lift) on PR #476 brings each term individually to mpmath precision.  **Precision note**: the stored `output_value` (2.3414189909034892767924676758097031775873056902241) is a 4-sig-fig rounded summary of the upstream pipeline output, kept short for readability in the chain JSON.  The full-precision 50 dps values live in `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json`; downstream code that needs >4 sig figs should read from that witness rather than from this chain step.

steps.name: m_e_Hecke (electron mass in cat units, 50 dps)
steps.operation: Same tower formula applied to the electron's 2-strand atomic braid; 50 dps via the same mpmath pipeline.
steps.notes: script: computations/mass_endomorphism.py electron-tower path.  SCRIPT_CITED until an electron-tr-M-q0 chain ships.  **Precision note**: the stored `output_value` (2.00272236446270199452458170801238844660674387057392118180329) is a 4-sig-fig rounded summary of the upstream pipeline output, kept short for readability in the chain JSON.  Full-precision 50 dps values live in `mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps.witness.json`.

steps.name: Dimensionless mass ratio m_p/m_e at 50 dps
steps.operation: Compute the ratio m_p_Hecke / m_e_Hecke at 50 dps.  The framework predicts this ratio dimensionlessly; CODATA fixes the absolute scale via m_e.
steps.notes: Pure arithmetic (ratio of two 50 dps values).

steps.name: Scale by CODATA m_e (MeV) → m_p in MeV
steps.operation: m_p (MeV) := (m_p_Hecke / m_e_Hecke) × M_E_MEV.  M_E_MEV = 0.51099895069 MeV is the **single CODATA-bounded constant** the framework consumes.
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf: m_p_pred ≈ 966.05 MeV vs CODATA m_p = 938.27208816 MeV.  Current relative error: 0.0296 = 2.9605e+7 ppb (target: 1 ppb, gap of ~6 orders of magnitude).  Closing the gap requires Phase A item completion (Terms 2-6 at full 50 dps without f64 chokepoints) + Phase B (q_0 derivation).
